user_query: I'm organizing a photography exhibition and I need to print high-quality posters of my photos. Can you recommend some printing services that offer large format printing? Also, provide the pricing details for different sizes of posters and check if they offer any discounts for bulk orders. Additionally, find out if they provide delivery services.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of printing services that offer large format printing.
Check and collect pricing details for different poster sizes from the identified printing services.
Inquire about bulk order discounts from the selected printing services.
Find out if the printing services offer delivery options and their associated costs.
